fields.summary: User login with email and password
fields.description:
As a user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can access my account securely.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am a registered user with valid credentials, when I submit my email and password, then I should be successfully logged in and receive an access token
• Given I provide invalid credentials, when I attempt to log in, then I should receive an authentication error message
• Given I have exceeded login attempts, when I try to log in, then my account should be temporarily locked with appropriate error messaging

As a user, I want to enable MFA on my account so that I can add an extra layer of security to protect my data.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am logged in, when I enable MFA and provide a valid authenticator app, then MFA should be activated on my account
• Given I have MFA enabled, when I log in, then I should be prompted for a second authentication factor
• Given I provide an incorrect MFA code, when I submit it, then I should receive an error and be able to retry

As a system, I want to generate and validate JWT tokens so that authenticated users can access protected resources.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given a user successfully authenticates, when the system generates tokens, then an access token with 15-minute expiry and refresh token with 7-day expiry should be created
• Given an expired access token, when the system validates it, then it should reject the request and return an authentication error
• Given a valid refresh token, when the user requests a new access token, then a new access token should be generated

As a user, I want to sign in with Google or Microsoft so that I can quickly access the system without creating a new account.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I choose to sign in with Google, when I authorize the application, then I should be logged in and my profile created if it doesn't exist
• Given I have an existing account, when I sign in with OAuth, then my accounts should be linked appropriately
• Given OAuth provider is unavailable, when I attempt OAuth login, then I should receive an appropriate error message

As a user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my credentials.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I request a password reset, when I provide my email address, then I should receive a password reset email with a secure token
• Given I have a valid reset token, when I submit a new password, then my password should be updated and I should be able to log in
• Given an expired or invalid reset token, when I attempt to reset my password, then I should receive an error message

As a new user, I want to create a profile with my personal information so that I can personalize my account experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am a new user, when I submit valid profile information including name and email, then my profile should be created and stored
• Given I submit incomplete required fields, when I create a profile, then I should receive validation errors for missing fields
• Given I submit a duplicate email, when I create a profile, then I should receive an error indicating the email already exists

As a user, I want to update my profile details so that I can keep my account information current and accurate.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am logged in, when I update my profile with valid information, then the changes should be saved and reflected in my profile
• Given I try to update with invalid data, when I submit the changes, then I should receive validation errors
• Given I update my email, when I save the changes, then I should receive an email verification for the new address

As a user, I want to upload and change my profile picture so that I can personalize my account appearance.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am logged in, when I upload a valid image file, then it should be stored securely and associated with my profile
• Given I upload an invalid file type, when I submit it, then I should receive an error message about supported formats
• Given I have an existing avatar, when I upload a new one, then the old avatar should be replaced and the storage cleaned up

As a user, I want to set and modify my account preferences so that the system behaves according to my needs.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am logged in, when I update my preferences, then the changes should be saved and applied to my account experience
• Given I set invalid preference values, when I submit them, then I should receive validation errors
• Given I have preferences set, when I view my profile, then I should see my current preference settings

As a user, I want to permanently delete my account so that I can remove my data from the system when no longer needed.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am logged in, when I request account deletion, then I should receive confirmation and my account should be marked for deletion
• Given I confirm account deletion, when the process completes, then all my personal data should be permanently removed from the system
• Given I delete my account, when I try to log in afterwards, then I should receive an error that the account doesn't exist

As an administrator, I want to create and define roles with specific permissions so that I can control user access to system features.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I create a role with specific permissions, then the role should be saved with those permissions
• Given I define overlapping permissions, when I create roles, then the permission structure should be properly validated
• Given I delete a role, when users have that role assigned, then I should be notified about the impact and handle reassignment

As an administrator, I want to assign roles to users so that they receive appropriate access permissions for their responsibilities.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I assign a role to a user, then the user should immediately receive those permissions
• Given I remove a role from a user, when they access the system, then they should no longer have those permissions
• Given I assign multiple roles, when checking user permissions, then all assigned role permissions should be aggregated

As a system, I want to check user permissions in real-time so that only authorized users can access protected resources.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given a user requests access to a protected resource, when I check their permissions, then access should be granted only if they have the required permission
• Given a user's permissions change, when they access cached permissions, then the cache should reflect the most current permissions
• Given permission validation fails, when a user attempts access, then they should receive a clear access denied message

As a compliance officer, I want to track all changes to user roles and permissions so that I can maintain an audit trail for security reviews.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given any role or permission change occurs, when the change is made, then it should be logged with timestamp, user, and details
• Given I need to review changes, when I query the audit log, then I should see a complete history of role and permission modifications
• Given audit data exists, when generating compliance reports, then all relevant changes should be included in the report

As an administrator, I want to view and search through all user accounts so that I can efficiently manage user information.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I request the user list, then I should see all users with pagination support
• Given I search for users by email or name, when I submit the search, then I should receive filtered results matching the criteria
• Given there are many users, when I view the list, then results should load quickly with proper pagination

As an administrator, I want to activate, deactivate, or suspend user accounts so that I can control user access to the system.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I deactivate a user account, then the user should no longer be able to log in
• Given a user is deactivated, when I reactivate their account, then they should be able to log in again
• Given I suspend a user temporarily, when the suspension period ends, then their access should be automatically restored

As an administrator, I want to generate reports on user activity and system usage so that I can monitor system health and user engagement.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I request an activity report, then I should receive comprehensive user activity data for the specified time period
• Given I need system metrics, when I generate reports, then I should see login rates, active users, and system usage statistics
• Given I export report data, when the export completes, then I should receive the data in the requested format (CSV, PDF, etc.)

As an administrator, I want to modify system configuration settings so that I can customize the system behavior for organizational needs.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Given I am an administrator, when I update system settings, then the changes should be applied immediately and stored persistently
• Given I modify security settings, when users access the system, then the new security policies should be enforced
• Given I change configuration, when I view the settings, then I should see the current configuration values

fields.summary: Create core user tables and schema
fields.description: As a developer, I want to implement the database schema for users, roles, and sessions so that the system can store and retrieve user data efficiently.
As a developer, I want to create optimized database indexes so that user queries respond within performance requirements.

fields.summary: Set up database migrations and versioning
fields.description: As a developer, I want to implement database migration scripts so that schema changes can be deployed safely and consistently.
